$comment: Machine-readable statement of the unsolved Liber Primus problem. Generated by analysis/handoff/build_problem.py — do not hand-edit.

problem.name: Cicada 3301 Liber Primus, part 2, pages 0-54
problem.task: Recover the plaintext of 12,956 runes of ciphertext.

alphabet.name: Gematria Primus (Anglo-Saxon futhorc)
alphabet.note: 7 of 29 runes transliterate to TWO characters (TH EO NG OE AE IA EA), and the alphabet is lossy: no K (->C), no Q, no V (->U), no Z. Any scorer trained on raw English is therefore scoring a different distribution than the decoder emits — see analysis/round15/SCORER/FINDING.md.

interrupter.note: On SOLVED pages this rune sometimes acts as a skip marker rather than a letter. 458 occurrences (3.54%) in the unsolved stream.

ciphertext_identity.why_this_matters: If your pipeline does not produce exactly 12,956 runes with this hash, you are not solving the same object and no number in this repo is comparable to yours.

measured_statistics.note: The doublet rate is THE anomaly: ~0.66% against a >=1.38% plaintext-independent floor for running keys. Everything in the verdict rests on it. Independently recomputed in round12/D2.

acceptance_criteria.$comment: Fixed in advance. verify_solution.py enforces exactly these.
acceptance_criteria.null: size-matched shuffle, n=200; candidate must beat null max by 0.5
acceptance_criteria.score_semantics: per-quadgram log-probability; NEGATIVE, and HIGHER is more English. Genuine solved pages land -4.1 to -5.0. Noise is about -7.5.
acceptance_criteria.scale_warning: A fixed -5.5 bar is INVALID at very large trial counts: the null maximum grows like sd*sqrt(2 ln N). Use benchmark/null.py threshold_for(n_trials, segment_len). This is the single most common way a large sweep fools its operator.

current_verdict.statement: OTP-class. The ciphertext is indistinguishable between a TRUE EXTERNAL PAD (information-theoretically closed) and a keystream DERIVED FROM A SHORT SEED (finite keyspace, brute-forceable). Only running the derived-key search settles which.
current_verdict.do_not_say: Do NOT state 'information-theoretically unsolvable' without that qualification. That was this repo's own overreach, caught by round12/D3, and it foreclosed a real tractable lane.

method_requirements.$comment: Non-negotiable if you want a result anyone can use.
method_requirements.trust_anchor: python3 liber-primus/tests/validate.py must print ALL VALIDATIONS PASSED before any result is meaningful.
method_requirements.positive_control: Plant a known signal and prove your instrument recovers it BEFORE trusting any null. A negative from an unvalidated instrument is not a negative. Gates live in liber-primus/benchmark/.
method_requirements.pre_registration: Write your hypothesis, search bound and pass/fail threshold BEFORE running. Every round here has a PREREG.md.
method_requirements.beam_not_rigid: CRITICAL: under the anti-repeat filter, RIGID decoding returns NOISE (-6.835) even on the CORRECT key, while the skip-aware beam recovers it (-4.170). Billions of decodes in this repo's history were run through a decoder that could not have succeeded. Use beam_decode.
method_requirements.state_your_power: Report the smallest signal your instrument could have detected, not just that you found nothing.

search_space_status.$comment: Summary only. LEDGER.json is authoritative and queryable.

if_you_think_you_solved_it: 2. Run it on your candidate with --key-module or --keystream
3. If PASS: re-run from a clean checkout, then over all 55 pages
4. Read the plaintext yourself - does it read as prose in the voice of the solved pages, or as word-salad that merely scores?
5. Take it to CicadaSolvers for independent reproduction. A solve is accepted by the community, not by a script.
